summary: Tested new FREE menu-photo path (POST /api/ai/menu-photos/suggest-free) end-to-end. Backend: 8/9 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_free_menu_photos.py (auth 401/403, validation 422 x3, happy-path 200 with real JPEG from Pollinations verified via GET, paid /suggest regression). Frontend smoke on live preview confirmed the emerald ImageIcon renders per row with data-testid=menu-free-photo-{item_id}, correct title, animate-pulse during request, both row buttons disable together (single-row busy invariant), and the click chain FREE→PATCH→reload updates the item image (FREE_API 200, PATCH 200). BUG FOUND: free-photo rows DO inflate the ₹ spend dashboard because the aggregator in server.py:_sum sums count_generated regardless of cost_inr. Spec requirement violated.

critical.issue: Free-photo rows inserted by /suggest-free (cost_inr=0, count_generated=1) INFLATE the ₹ totals by ₹3.5 per row. The aggregator's $sum on count_generated does not filter cost_inr==0 rows. Verified by test_free_rows_do_not_inflate_spend which fails with delta_spend=₹3.5. Fix: in server.py:762 add `{cost_inr: {$ne: 0}}` to the $match (or use `$ifNull cost_inr` differently), OR change /suggest-free to store count_generated=0 for free rows.

action_items: Fix spend-inflation bug: filter cost_inr==0 rows out of the /api/admin/ai-photos/spend aggregation (server.py ai_photo_spend._sum). Re-run test_free_rows_do_not_inflate_spend to confirm.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:762 _sum() aggregates count_generated + filled without checking cost_inr — free rows leak into paid spend totals. Add `cost_inr: {$ne: 0}` (or `$or: [cost_inr null, cost_inr > 0]`) to each $match.

ai_menu_photos.py:198 Unsplash Source URL is used but Unsplash Source has been deprecated (Jun 2024) — every request 302→ a generic-looking image or returns HTML. In practice only Pollinations serves real bytes here; the code correctly falls through. Consider removing the Unsplash tier or replacing with Unsplash API + key.

ai_menu_photos.py:204 requests.get inside lambda is fine, but a per-source timeout of 30s means a completely stalled Unsplash call blocks the request path for 30s before falling back. Consider dropping to 10s for the first source.
MenuTab.js correctly gates click via aiBusyId so only one row is busy at a time. Verified live.
MenuPhotoFreeRequest has min_length=1 for name but the /suggest paid variant enforces min_length=2 — inconsistency, though not spec-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 1 corporate client (TEST_Corp_*), 1 site (TEST_Site_*), 1 vendor_onboarding (TEST_ui_*) with 2 draft_menu items (Paneer Masala, Chicken Biryani). Onboarding + site DELETED after test. Corporate client + city TEST rows left behind (preview DB had no cascade endpoint for corp deletion in this session).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite is /app/backend/tests/test_free_menu_photos.py. The test test_free_rows_do_not_inflate_spend currently FAILS by design — it will pass once the aggregator filters cost_inr==0. Everything else (auth 401/403, validation 422 x3, happy path with byte-size delta check, GET-image content-type check, paid endpoint regression) passes. Frontend UI is fully wired: data-testids `menu-free-photo-{item_id}` (emerald) and `menu-ai-photo-{item_id}` (violet) with animate-pulse and mutual-exclusion via aiBusyId.
rca of the issue: Root cause: server.py ai_photo_spend uses `$sum: {$ifNull: [count_generated, {$ifNull: [filled, 0]}]}` and multiplies by fixed PRICE_PER_IMAGE_INR=3.5. When the new /suggest-free path was added, it also writes to ai_image_generations with count_generated=1 (and cost_inr=0), so the aggregator picks it up as if it were a paid gpt-image-1 call. Reproduction: master POST /api/ai/menu-photos/suggest-free {name:'Paneer'} → row inserted → GET /api/admin/ai-photos/spend shows +₹3.5 in month_to_date. Mitigation options: (a) filter `cost_inr: {$ne: 0}` in each $match, OR (b) sum a computed field `count_generated * (cost_inr>0 ? 1 : 0)`, OR (c) write source='free' rows to a distinct collection. Option (a) is smallest diff.
